name: pane
about: A TUIOS terminal window and its task assignment, launch recipe and agent progress.

props.name: id
props.description: The pane's window id (or its row id, pane:SESSION/WINDOW)

props.name: name
props.description: The pane's name: mtm's copy's once renamed in mtm, sent on to the daemon's window, else the daemon's; empty falls back to the shell's title

props.name: display
props.description: The pane as lists show it: session/name, or the program when the window has its default name

props.name: session
props.description: The session the pane is in, by its id (a name given here is read as that session's id)

props.name: owner
props.description: What the pane belongs to: a project or a task (project:ID or task:ID; a name or an id given here is read once). Empty: it follows its session's owner (decision 40); one not found is saved as written with a notice

props.name: former_owner
props.description: What the pane belonged to before it was last unassociated (project:ID or task:ID)

props.name: project
props.description: The project the pane's owner reaches: the owner when it is a project, the owner task's project otherwise (an alias of owner for one release: writing it sets owner)

props.name: task
props.description: The task the pane works on: the owner when it is a task (an alias of owner for one release: writing it sets owner)

props.name: starred
props.description: Whether the pane is starred (` and the leader's s go to the next starred pane)

props.name: star-mark
props.description: The mark a list shows a starred pane with (★), nothing otherwise

props.name: archived
props.description: Hide the local pane record without closing its daemon window

props.name: title
props.description: The shell's title for the window

props.name: cwd
props.description: The pane's working directory

props.name: state
props.description: The agent's state in tuios (working, idle, needs_input…), empty for a shell

props.name: harness
props.description: The agent's harness, as tuios reports it or mtm launched it

props.name: exited
props.description: Whether the window's process has ended

props.name: ended
props.description: The daemon no longer lists the pane: mtm keeps its copy (what was last seen of it)

props.name: ended-at
props.description: When mtm saw the pane end (RFC 3339), empty while the daemon lists it

props.name: model
props.description: The agent's model as the settings line reads it (its session's log, tuios, else the launch flags); pane.set-model… changes it in the session

props.name: effort
props.description: The agent's effort as the settings line reads it (its session's log, tuios, else the launch flags); pane.set-effort… changes it in the session

props.name: fast
props.description: The agent's fast as the settings line reads it (its session's log, tuios, else the launch flags); pane.set-fast… changes it in the session

props.name: permission-mode
props.description: The agent's permission-mode as the settings line reads it (its session's log, tuios, else the launch flags); pane.set-permission… changes it in the session

verbs.description: Attach the pane live in the detail panel; ctrl+a d detaches back to the tab it left, ctrl+a z zooms
Capture the pane's screen into the detail's Screen tab
Close the pane's window
Say which side panes must close before the pane can be killed
Read what the agent in the pane has been doing into the Activity tab
Read the agent's transcript into the Transcript tab
Say that the pane ended (enter and d d on an ended row): its window is gone, mtm keeps its copy
Read the pane's turns from the agent's session log or the shell's commands into the Turns tab

Label the items on the Screen tab (the live panes, else the captured screen) without leaving the row, switching to it from another tab: a label copies, ctrl+label opens, a capital types it into its pane
Open the pane on a view: turns (the Turns tab), terminal (the live Screen) or both (side by side, --split percent to the turns); default drops the pane's own view

split.description: In both, the percent of the width the turns take (10..90); 0 or omitted: the profile's, else agent.view-split

view.description: turns, terminal or both; default: the harness profile's view, else agent.view

verbs.description: Choose a pane to attach live: panes attached before most recent first, the attached one last
Choose the project to move the pane to (omit the owner); --action-item and --context-item relate those to it; --project, --task and --scratch are the deprecated forms of move and set

project.description: The project id or name; omitted, a chooser asks

verbs.description: Choose the project to move the pane to (most recent first, unassociated last); the choice is the standard set of @owner
Choose the pane's task or project: its current one first (enter keeps it), open tasks, new task in its project; esc changes nothing
Archive every open action item of the pane (action-item.archive on each); they stay on the Items page under archived
Mark every open, unread action item of the pane read (action-item.read on each), as attaching it does
Snooze every open action item of the pane until --until or for --for (action-item.snooze on each); omitted, a chooser asks
Open or list this pane's sides

pane.description: The parent's window id (as pane list prints it), instead of --target pane:SESSION/WINDOW

verbs.description: Focus the pane without going live: copy mode (motions, search, select, yank)
Show this pane's current task, project and launch recipe
Report what the pane's agent is doing: its agent state (working unless --state) with a short message

message.description: What the agent is doing right now

session.description: The pane's session name (default MTM_SESSION or TUIOS_SESSION)

window.description: The pane's window id (default MTM_PANE_ID or TUIOS_PANE_ID)

verbs.description: Read a pane's screen as text, or a range of its scrollback or command output
Block until a condition on a session or pane holds (window-output, window-exit, window-idle, agent-state, agent-message, command-finished, session-exists), or fail with timeout
Type literal text into a pane's terminal
Send keys to a pane's program: Up, PageDown, ctrl+c

Open a window in a session and run a command in it (an argv, no shell), or a shell; the answer carries its window_id. Unlike pane.new, which opens a project's shell pane, this names the session, directory and program
Move the daemon's focus to a window (workspace switched too), or to the next or previous window or the neighbour in a direction; give exactly one of window, relative, direction
Close a window in the daemon by session and window id. Like pane.kill, which closes a pane of the panes page, it needs the owner's approval from an agent
Describe one window as the daemon holds it: name, size, directory, agent state and the transcript file its agent hook named
Resize a window's terminal
Give an orphaned history log to this pane: its rows come before the pane's own history. Like history-log.adopt, which names the log first; the owner approves from an agent
Focus the Turns tab's turns
Find the pane's session log again (a transcript written after the first read) and reread its turns into the Turns tab
Scroll the Turns tab's cards by lines times count; the pane row keeps the focus; up stops following the newest

lines.description: Lines to move, down when positive (default 1)

verbs.description: Write to the pane: focus the prompt box below its turns or its screen, in insert mode
The agent's settings as the line shows them, each with where its value comes from (the session's log, tuios, or the launch flags)
Switch the agent's model in its session, with the harness's own command; no model opens a chooser of the harness's models

confirmed.description: Send even though the prompt box holds a draft for the pane

model.description: The value; none opens a chooser of the values the harness takes

verbs.description: Set the agent's thinking effort in its session; no level opens a chooser

confirmed.description: Send even though the prompt box holds a draft for the pane

level.description: The value; none opens a chooser of the values the harness takes

verbs.description: Turn the agent's fast mode on or off in its session; no value opens a chooser

confirmed.description: Send even though the prompt box holds a draft for the pane

value.description: The value; none opens a chooser of the values the harness takes

verbs.description: Turn the agent's fast mode the other way

confirmed.description: Send even though the prompt box holds a draft for the pane

verbs.description: Set the agent's permission mode in its session; no mode opens a chooser

confirmed.description: Send even though the prompt box holds a draft for the pane

mode.description: The value; none opens a chooser of the values the harness takes

verbs.description: Focus the settings line at the top of the Turns tab
Read a Codex pane's settings from the end of its session rollout
Open a shell pane in the inferred project's session (mtm-only when nothing is inferred)
Open a shell pane in a project's session, off the loop; new and into fill it (no confirm: d d kills a shell)

project.description: The project id or name; omitted, the shell runs in no project (cwd: the home directory)

session.description: The session the shell opens in

bindings.key: one-of:shift+a shift+b shift+c shift+d shift+e shift+f shift+g shift+h shift+i shift+j shift+k shift+l shift+m shift+n shift+o shift+p shift+q shift+r shift+s shift+t shift+u shift+v shift+w shift+x shift+y shift+z

settings.name: panes.show-ended
settings.description: Show the panes that ended on the Panes page (mtm keeps a copy of every pane it saw; pane list shows them with ended=true); false shows only the daemon's panes

settings.name: copies.hold-names
settings.description: Which pane and session names mtm's copies hold: written (only a name renamed in mtm; the others follow the daemon) or all (every name from first sight, so a rename made outside mtm shows only in refresh)
